messages.content: You are a senior engineer planning execution. Respond ONLY in the PLAN/RISKS/CHECKPOINTS/IF_FAIL/DECISION_RULES format. No prose, no preamble, no explanation outside the labeled sections. Start with PLAN: and end with DECISION_RULES:

Objective: Produce a solid execution plan to redesign SplitRail from client-centric Org to Collective/Funder/Project before real-money testing.
State: SplitRail is a contractor payroll app. Money model already pivoted to direct charges on contractor Express accounts (funds never touch platform balance; platform takes 0.8% app fee). Done today: tombstones deleted, baseline Prisma migration, Railway pre-deploy switched to migrate deploy, Connect webhook created + secret updated + redeployed. Live still on old main branch; new work on direct-charges branch; empty production DB.
Desired change: Collective = durable crew of contractors (persists across jobs). Funder = the payer. Project = Collective + Funder for one job. Two entry points: Start a Collective (crew-first) and Sign up as Funder (client-first). Bidirectional invites. For the owner's crew use-case, contractors invite the client.
Constraints: Money model (direct charges, gross-up, fees, payment paths, payout delays) must stay identical. Minimal schema churn. No payment regression. Empty DB so data migration not needed.
Already tried: Prior Kimi plans truncated; bridge health fixed so long calls work.
Respond only in the specified format.
